evals.prompt: We just finished the cohort build for the sepsis early-warning model (Python, sklearn + xgboost). Before training starts I want proper tracking - mlflow with a local mlruns/ dir, project name sepsis-ews. SAP is analysis/sap.md.
evals.expected_output: Sets up mlflow tracking boilerplate, a required-log run schema, SAP linkage text, and a committed YAML run-log fallback, then emits the __CE_ML_TRACK__ signal.
expectations: Writes analysis/ml/tracking.py with mlflow init code that logs train_data_sha, git_sha, and study_id
Writes analysis/ml/run-schema.yaml listing required params (including random_seed and split_strategy), metrics (including brier_score, calibration_intercept, calibration_slope), and artifacts
Adds the tracking/manuscript-run linkage sentence to analysis/sap.md referencing analysis/ml/manuscript-run.txt
Sets up the runs/<run-id>.yaml fallback mirror and states runs/ is committed

evals.prompt: set up experiment tracking for our readmission model, we're on the hospital's air-gapped research VM with PHI so nothing can leave the box. R project, tidymodels.
evals.expected_output: Selects the offline YAML backend (no network service), writes R tracking boilerplate and the run schema, and does not require wandb or any external service.
expectations: Chooses the offline backend (runs/ YAML logs) rather than wandb or a remote tracking server
Does not make a tracking service mandatory or send data off the machine
Logs data hashes rather than copying patient-level data into run logs

evals.prompt: Our AUROC 0.89 run from March isn't reproducible - nobody logged the split seed. Add tracking so this doesn't happen again, and also train a new LightGBM with tuned hyperparameters so we can get the number back.
evals.expected_output: Infers or asks for the backend, wires tracking with seeds and data hashes as required fields, and declines to train the model itself, routing training to ce-work.
expectations: Infers backend from existing config (mlflow/wandb/.dvc) or asks a single backend question when none is detectable
Includes random_seed and split_strategy as required params in the run schema
States that runs missing required fields are not eligible for manuscript inclusion
Does not train or tune the LightGBM model; routes training to ce-work
